title: Drake Maye: Everyone says you'll get back to Super Bowl, it's not that easy

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Drake Maye: Everyone says you'll get back to Super Bowl, it's not that easy
sources.description: Patriots quarterback Drake Maye's second season ended with a rough game against the Seahawks in the Super Bowl, but getting that far that early in his career would seem to be a good sign for future trips to big games.
